entries.만 3개월 미만의 영아는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을 복용하기 전: Infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. entries.만 7세 미만의 어린이 및 만 2세 미만의 영아, 이 약에 과민증 환자: Children under 7 years of age and infants under 2 years of age, and patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine or a history of it, must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, people with an allergic constitution, people who have experienced allergic symptoms from medicines including nasal sprays for rhinitis, pregnant women, women who may be pregnant, patients with hypersensitivity to propylene glycol or a history of it, and patients with high blood pressure, heart disease, diabetes, thyroid disease, or glaucoma should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Before using this medicine, people with smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, a cough with excessive phlegm, a cough lasting 1 week or longer or recurring, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever and rash or a persistent headache should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine only as a nasal spray for rhinitis, that is, a medicine sprayed inside the nose. Do not use it in the eyes or ears. Do not share it with others, in order to prevent contamination. Drowsiness may occur while using it. Take care when driving a car or operating machinery. If it does not improve after 3 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not use it continuously for more than 7 days. Children should use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Follow the specified dosage and administration carefully. Excessive use may instead cause nasal congestion.

Taking this medicine may cause constipation.
